The global "Big 5" pharmaceutical companies are traditionally **Johnson & Johnson**, **Roche**, **Pfizer**, **Merck & Co.**, and **Novartis**. These industry leaders rank at the top based on annual global revenue, massive research and development (R&D) budgets, and broad market influence.

- **Johnson & Johnson (USA):** Focuses on innovative medicines (immunology and oncology) alongside medical technology.

- **Roche (Switzerland):** A leader in biotechnology and targeted oncology medicines, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

- **Pfizer (USA):** A massive research-based biopharmaceutical firm known for global vaccine distribution and prescription drugs.

- **Merck & Co. (USA):**

Renowned for blockbuster oncology treatments (like Keytruda) and vaccines.

- **Novartis (Switzerland):** Specializes in core therapeutic areas including immunology, neuroscience, and cardiovascular care. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/pharmaceutical-companies/)
